reason: I have one chair, maybe two, and I am cutting hair myself all day, so I already know who is in the chair and how much cash is in the drawer. I paid for salon software once and it got cancelled because nobody used it, so ₹4,999 plus ₹999 every month is too much for things my notebook and WhatsApp already do.
objection: I already wasted money on software nobody used. And if the phone breaks or the app company shuts down, what happens to my customer list?
would_change_my_mind: A cheaper version for a one-chair shop with no setup fee, only the WhatsApp reminders and customer list, and proof that my data stays safe if the phone is lost.
